# relgap config

Configuration is layered; later layers win:

```text
  defaults < user file < project file < env (RELGAP_*) < flags

User file:    $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/relgap/config.yaml (~/.config/relgap/config.yaml)
Project file: .relgap.yaml, found by walking up from the working directory to the git root
Env vars:     RELGAP_<KEY> with dots and dashes as underscores, e.g. RELGAP_GITHUB_CONCURRENCY=4.
              Use __ to mark nesting explicitly (RELGAP_SCAN__DETECTORS__CI_ACTIONS=true).
              Only scalars and string lists can be set; lists are comma-separated.
              Maps and lists of objects need a file. An unknown RELGAP_* variable is
              ignored with a warning.
```

Unknown keys and wrong types are errors (exit 2), reported with file:line:column.
'relgap config init' writes a commented file to start from. Every key, its default and
its variable are listed at https://relgap.sasskovacs.dev/reference/config.

## Usage

```sh
relgap config <command>
```

The [global flags](/cli/global-flags) work with every command.

## Examples

```sh
relgap config init
relgap config show --sources
relgap config validate .relgap.yaml
```
